sentences.text: Megamonas funiformis was proposed as a new species for an isolate of non-spore-forming, Gram-negative, very large rods most closely related to Megamonas hypermegale.
Megamonas species have been detected by metagenomic sequencing of stool from children and adolescents enrolled at a children's hospital.
A study reported that oral Megamonas funiformis CML154 improved fatty liver disease in hens and mice and raised intestinal propionate.
A study reported a 16S sequence feature assigned to Megamonas hypermegale depleted in hepatic fibrosis, and indole-3-lactic acid as a metabolite of that species.
The same metagenomic study reported the genus Megamonas enriched in children and adolescents with non-alcoholic fatty liver disease compared with healthy children.
